sentences.en: Lend me a knife with which to peel this pear.
sentences.zh: 借我一把刀来削这个梨。

sentences.en: His fake moustache started to peel off on one side.
sentences.zh: 他的人造胡子开始从一边脱落。

sentences.en: Maybe we should've peeled the apples before we ate them.
sentences.zh: 也许我们应该在吃之前把苹果削了。

senses.zh: 果皮，蔬菜皮；长柄木铲；英史堡寨，堡宅
